observations: For Robin: V3's grading delta puts the holes 2.5 mm in from each edge (pitch 75 x 35). Neither the V3 request text ('a mounting hole in each corner') nor parts/perfboard/part.json says so: the catalogue's hole_inset = 2.0 was measured from the photo of the 70 x 50 board. Following the rubric, the judge graded against the delta and records the defect at the part.json field. But the agent cannot derive 2.5 from its inputs, so every V3 run will fail L1.3 until the request or the catalogue carries the hole positions. Please decide whether the V3 request should state the hole inset, or whether the delta should be 2.0. Either way the fix belongs in data, not in agent logic.
Physically, with the holes at 2.5 inset, an M2 screw through a O2.0 board hole would land 0.71 mm off the centre of a O1.70 pilot, so it could not go in square.

model_front.png / model_back.png show a small orange speck on the left corner boss about 4 mm below the seam. It is not an opening: the boss pilot (O2.5, Z 19.1..25.2) is fully enclosed by the O6.6 boss (2.05 mm ligament), and wall-slab decomposition finds no through region in the -Y/+Y walls. Most likely the highlight colour of the pilot cut showing in the render.

The USB opening is high (Z 7.0..14.8) and the jack opening is low (Z -1.9..6.9), as V3 expects. The ghost_left/ghost_right views look offset vertically only because the ortho view is tilted (the ports sit 3.2-4.6 mm behind the wall face).
notes: Every value was measured with manifold3d/trimesh on base.stl and lid.stl, with the references rebuilt independently from parts/*/part.json, the declared layout.json and the V3 grading deltas.
